meta.title: Real-Time Dashboard Widgets: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Navigate to the dashboard and observe whether Real-Time Dashboard Widgets are absent or unavailable on a below-Growth tenant.
Verify that the same widgets are available and usable on a Growth tenant.
Select or provision tenants by plan while keeping the same All Users persona.
